TIDUS-BROTHERHOOD.description: Gain 5 [gold]Overdrive[/gold] at the start of every turn. [gold]Overkill[/gold] enemies to gain better rewards.
TIDUS-BROTHERHOOD.title: Brotherhood
TIDUS-CALADBOLG.description: Upgrade your [gold]Overdrive[/gold]. Gain 3 additional [gold]Overdrive[/gold] from Attacks, and from [gold]Blitz[/gold] activation.
TIDUS-CALADBOLG.flavor: This should really be called Ultima Weapon
TIDUS-CALADBOLG.title: Caladbolg
TIDUS-LONGSWORD.description: At the start of combat, apply 1 [gold]Delay[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TIDUS-LONGSWORD.title: Longsword
TIDUS-ASCALON.flavor: A sword used to slay dragons.
TIDUS-ASCALON.title: Ascalon
TIDUS-APOCALYPSE.flavor: To draw this black blade is to know the horrors of war and welcome them.
TIDUS-APOCALYPSE.title: Apocalypse
TIDUS-TRI_STEEL.description: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, gain 3 [gold]Vigor[/gold].
TIDUS-TRI_STEEL.flavor: Jack of all trades, master of none.
TIDUS-TRI_STEEL.title: Tri-Steel
TIDUS-FORCE_SABER.description: At the start of combat, gain 1 [gold]Haste[/gold].
TIDUS-FORCE_SABER.title: Force Saber
TIDUS-OFFICIAL_BALL.description: At the start of combat, add 2 random [gold]Blitz[/gold] cards to your hand.
TIDUS-OFFICIAL_BALL.flavor: The ball every blitzball player dreams of holding.
TIDUS-OFFICIAL_BALL.title: Official Ball
